facts.text: Cedric signed a promissory note to pay the party 975 gold pieces (three-quarters price) for their treasure, collectable once the caravans flow to Brandonsford again.
facts.uncertain_reason: Unclear whether the party still holds the note or pledged it to Malzazarik and Lady Hilda when recruiting them.

facts.text: The party owes the wizard Malzazarik and Lady Hilda payment from Cedric's promissory note, which recruited them; the exact shares are not stated and the note pays only once the caravans flow again.
facts.uncertain_reason: The terms of the recruitment, including each recruit's share and whether the note itself was handed over, were not spelled out.
